mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <60% of FEDFUNDS decline periods or rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward movement in the unemployment rate above 4.5% percentage points triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting investor concerns about labor market weakening.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE crossing above 4.5% threshold in 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in demand (GDPC1) and decrease in federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) creates a positive feedback loop, amplifying equity valuations and generating S&P 500 forward returns of at least 1% over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 up 2% and FEDFUNDS down 0.5% in the same month
failure_condition: 60d returns fail to exceed 1% in 70% of interaction instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (rising FEDFUNDS), investors anticipate higher interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as growth expectations decline.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain non-negative in >60% of tightening periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) signals robust supply-side growth, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns fail to correlate with INDPRO growth (rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year window).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the HOUST series below 1000 units triggers immediate negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days, reflecting reduced demand for goods and services.
failure_condition: 5d returns remain non-negative despite HOUST dropping below 1000 in 80% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) and demand (GDPC1) signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns of at least 0.5% over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS up 1% and GDPC1 up 1% in the same month
failure_condition: 20d returns fail to exceed 0.5% in 60% of interaction instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle labor expansion characterized by low unemployment (UNRATE <4%) and accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS <4.5%), investors anticipate sustained growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain below 1% in >70% of late-cycle instances.
